prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1341; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was changing lanes on a busy road in Pasadena, Texas, when the car in the lane I was moving into drifted over and sideswiped the passenger side of my vehicle. I pulled onto the shoulder right away and checked on everyone. My car had scraped paint and a cracked side mirror, and the impact jolted my back enough that I felt a sharp strain in the lower back within the hour. I have given the same account every time I have spoken about the collision, whether to the other driver, the responding officer, or the adjuster, and I have not changed any detail. I am the named driver on this policy and was operating my own vehicle at the time. I am asking that the claim be reviewed so that my medical treatment and the vehicle repairs can be covered.
